info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Branch Currency Distribution Review-spec
info.description: The Branch Currency Distribution Review Submission API allows users to submit reviews of currency distributions at specific branch channels. This endpoint facilitates the creation of reviews, which are essential for monitoring and improving currency allocation processes in financial institutions. Typical consumers of this API include branch managers and financial analysts looking to optimize branch performance. By utilizing this API, organizations can ensure systematic evaluation and feedback on currency distribution practices.

post.summary: Submit a review for a specific branch currency distribution.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for the branch currency distribution identified by RES-100045. Provide the necessary review details in the request body, and your feedback will help improve the service.
